header.title: Glitch
header.description: Cyberpunk digital interference: RGB channel split, horizontal tears, scanlines and static, in short bursts. `variant` sets the pattern (`cyber`, `rgb`, `slice` or `noise`) and `trigger` when it runs. By default it loops.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. Bursts land around 10%, 38% and 80% of each cycle, so wait a moment to see the strongest one.

image.title: On an image
image.description: With the defaults (`variant="cyber"`, `trigger="always"`) there are three bursts per `2200ms` cycle: it splits the red and blue channels, tears horizontal bands, shakes the content and adds scanlines and static. The root clips (`overflow: hidden`), so it carries the `border-radius`.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `cyber` combines everything. `rgb` only splits the channels with an SVG filter, `slice` only displaces bands (with the same filter) and adds color tears, and `noise` only draws scanlines and static, with no filter. All four shake the content in jumps (`steps()`), without sliding; `rgb` snaps even harder.

text.title: On text
text.description: Works the same on type. With large text and `intensity="lg"` the channel split is more visible.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: `always` loops, `hover` runs while the pointer is over it or keyboard focus is inside, and `click` toggles on each click. When off, the content stays still with no layers.

split.title: RGB split
split.description: `split` is how many pixels the channels separate at the peak of each burst. Without a value, `intensity` sets it: `2`, `4` or `8`. Only affects `cyber` and `rgb`.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is the length of a full cycle with its three bursts. `delay` postpones the start, handy to offset several elements.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` sets the RGB split (`2`, `4` or `8` px), the band displacement (`5`, `11` or `18` px) and the opacity of tears, scanlines and static. Takes a token or a number between `0` and `1`.

color.title: Color
color.description: `color` and `colorAlt` tint the tear gradients, so they only show with `cyber` and `slice`. The channel split always uses pure red and blue. Without a value, they use `primary-400` and `secondary-400`.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the distortion as it is: the jitter, tears, static and SVG filter stay on their last frame, and unpausing picks up from that same frame. `isDisabled` turns the effect off and leaves the content still and interactive.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild` the effect mounts on the child, with no wrapping `div`: the `h3` gets the root class, the RGB filter and the jitter, and the layers are inserted inside it. Void elements (`img`, `input`) have nowhere to hold them, so it falls back to the wrapping `div`.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onGlitch` fires when the effect turns on and `outGlitch` when it turns off, with the reason in `event.reason`. The layers have `pointer-events: none`, so the button still gets clicks.

texts.body: Hover the card (or Tab to the button) to glitch it and click the button.

header.title: Glitch API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Glitch`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every variant, trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/glitch` along with its `glitch.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> attributes (except color, which is its own prop) and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onFocus and onBlur run before the effect's internal logic.

items.photosensitivity: These are flashes and sudden jumps. To meet WCAG 2.3.1, avoid more than three flashes per second: don't lower duration too much and don't use it over large areas of the screen.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the content stays still, with no filter or tears, and only faint scanlines remain. The preference is tracked live: if it changes while the page is open, the glitch stops or comes back without reloading.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the glitch. Use it only when essential.
items.decorative: The filter svg and the layers have aria-hidden, and the layers pointer-events: none: they aren't announced and don't block clicks. Text stays readable for screen readers.
items.keyboard: With trigger="hover", keyboard focus (:focus-visible) on the root or a descendant activates the effect just like the pointer: the animated mode, the SVG filter, onGlitch and outGlitch. Mouse focus doesn't count. The root isn't focusable on its own: it needs a control inside or a tabIndex.
items.performance: With cyber, rgb and slice, each active instance runs a requestAnimationFrame loop that updates an SVG filter. Avoid many instances at once or on large elements.

items.live: Added while the effect runs (active and no reduced motion; with `hover`, from the pointer or keyboard focus). Enables every animation.
items.filter: Added while it runs with `cyber`, `rgb` or `slice`. Applies the SVG filter to the surface.
items.trigger: Added with `trigger="hover"` or `"click"` (there's no class for `always`).
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. Pauses (`animation-play-state: paused`) the jitter and the layer animations; JS freezes the SVG filter.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`. Removes the filter, the jitter and the layers.
items.defs: Zero-size `svg` holding the filter. Only exists with `cyber`, `rgb` and `slice`.
items.surface: Wraps the child (with `asChild`, it's the child itself). Gets the SVG filter and the jitter (`transform`).
items.layer: Decorative layer above the content (`aria-hidden`, `z-index: 2`, `pointer-events: none`).
items.slice: Color tears with `mix-blend-mode: screen`. Only exist with `cyber` and `slice`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: `duration`, `delay`, `split`, `intensity` and `filter` are written inline on every render, so you can only change them through the props. The colors are inline only when you pass `color` or `colorAlt`; otherwise you can override them from a class.

items.red: Warm tear color. Set by `color`; default `var(--gem-palette-primary-400)`.
items.cyan: Cool tear color. Set by `colorAlt`; default `var(--gem-palette-secondary-400)`.
items.intensity: Intensity as a percentage; drives the opacity of tears, scanlines and static.
items.split: RGB split in pixels. Informational: the CSS doesn't use it, JS applies the offset on the SVG filter.
items.filter: `url(#…)` of this instance's SVG filter (unique id from `useId`).

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Glitch reads as defaults. You can redefine them on the root with a class.

items.primary: Default `color`. If gem-system isn't loaded, falls back to `#ff2a6d`.
items.secondary: Default `colorAlt`. If gem-system isn't loaded, falls back to `#05d9e8`.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content gets the interference and where the effect mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Pattern, channel split, colors and intensity.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Burst cycle and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it runs and how it pauses or turns off.

items.children: Content that gets the glitch: an image, text or a card.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, with no wrapping `div`. With void elements (`img`, `input`) it falls back to the wrapping `div`, since the filter and the layers are inserted as children.
items.variant: `cyber` everything combined, `rgb` channel split only, `slice` displaced bands and tears only, `noise` scanlines and static only.
items.split: Channel split in pixels (negatives become `0`). Without a value, `intensity` sets it: `2`, `4` or `8`.
items.color: Warm tear color for `cyber` and `slice`. Any CSS color.
items.colorAlt: Cool tear color for `cyber` and `slice`. Any CSS color.
items.intensity: Distortion strength: split, displacement and layer opacity. Token or number between `0` and `1`.
items.duration: Length of one cycle with its three bursts. Negatives become `0`.
items.trigger: `always` loops, `hover` while the pointer is over it or keyboard focus is inside, `click` toggles on each click.
items.isActive: Allows the effect. When `false` it turns it off and `outGlitch` gets `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the current distortion on its last frame. Unpausing resumes from that frame.
items.isDisabled: Stops the effect; the child stays still and interactive. `outGlitch` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Runs even if the user prefers reduced motion. Without it, the effect follows the preference live. Only when essential.
items.onGlitch: Fires when the effect turns on: on mount with `always`, when the pointer or keyboard focus enters, or when toggled on by click.
items.outGlitch: Fires when it turns off: when the pointer or focus leaves, when toggled off by click, when deactivated or on unmount.
items.style: Root inline styles. Merged with the `--gemfx-glitch-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
